answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation is the task of converting structured data into natural language text that can be easily understood by humans.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text from structured data such as tables, knowledge graph triples, and meaning representations

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of generated texts using several widely accepted metrics. BLEU ... METEOR ... TER ... PARENT ... NIST ... CIDEr ... We also use the NLI score ... on the LogicNLG dataset to evaluate the logical fidelity, which is a model-based evaluation using the BERT model trained on the TabFact dataset.
